in_hindi.long_meaning: वर्धानार्ह वा अर्थात्मक वा अर्थात्मज वा अर्थार्ह यदि वा अर्थे रहने वाला, अर्हत: वर्धनार्ह, अर्थात्मक, अर्थात्मज, अर्थार्ह, यदि वा अर्थे रहने वाला

in_tamil.name: அர்ஹத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has realized the truth

in_telugu.name: అర్హత్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has realized the truth

in_marathi.name: Arhat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arhat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Buddhism, an Arhat is a person who has attained enlightenment. In Hinduism, Arhat is a term for a sage or spiritual teacher. The name derives from the Sanskrit word 'arhah', meaning 'deserving of respect'.

in_bengali.name: Arhat

in_bengali.long_meaning: Arhat একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Buddhism, an Arhat is a person who has attained enlightenment. In Hinduism, Arhat is a term for a sage or spiritual teacher. The name derives from the Sanskrit word 'arhah', meaning 'deserving of respect'.
